design.decision: Every round becomes a question of whether to bid nil now to grow the sigil, even on a hand that is only marginal for nil, because an early made nil pays off in every later round.
design.opponent: Its current value is public; opponents lead low and prioritize busting the team's nils as the multiplier grows.
design.rationale: Run-long growth is one thing rarity buys. The rare growth seeds measured −7 to −11, probably because +mult and nil-point growth is too small, so this tests compounding ×mult growth on the most reliable Nil trigger (cc-nil-made-mult fires about 39% of rounds).
design.draftText: This sigil gains ×0.5 contract multiplier every time your team makes a nil (currently ×1)

critic.concerns: Growth on a ~39% trigger snowballs from early purchases, and it is a third Nil growth sigil next to seed-grow-nil and uc-nil-grow-mult.
